texts.zh: 发生了一系列意外事件，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]似乎被悲伤所笼罩。在一个子个体的死亡之后，我们目睹了整个蜂巢出现了前所未有的工作停顿。我们不清楚这个子个体有什么与众不同之处，但蜂巢似乎正在举行某种仪式，死去的子个体几乎被虔诚地切成碎片，然后这些碎片被送到各个新生子个体的培育所。几分钟后，整个蜂巢又开始运转起来。这非常令人困惑，很像一个具有社会意义或精神意义的事件。
texts.en: In an unexpected turn of events, grief seems to have taken over [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. We are witnessing an unprecedented halt in the work of an entire hive, in the aftermath of the death of a singular drone. We are unsure why this drone is different from the others, but the hive seems to be holding some kind of ceremony, where the drone is almost religiously cut to pieces, before those pieces are taken to various nurseries for newborn drones. Moments later, the entire hive springs in motion again. This is highly confusing, and looks a lot like an event of social or spiritual importance.
